'''Bumble and bumble Products, LLC''', known more commonly as ''Bumble and Bumble''<ref name="ulta">{{Cite magazine |last=Kinonen |first=Sarah |date=2017-07-18 |title=Bumble and Bumble Is Coming to Ulta Beauty Stores This Fall |url=https://www.allure.com/story/bumble-and-bumble-ulta-beauty |magazine=Allure |language=en-US |access-date=2021-12-07}}</ref> is a hair salon and product company established in 1977 by hairdresser and entrepreneur Michael Gordon.<ref name= "tycoon">{{cite news |last=Yee |first=Vivian |authorlink=Vivian Yee |url= https://www.nytimes.com/2012/11/17/nyregion/founder-of-bumble-and-bumble-accused-of-hiding-30-million-from-irs.html |title=Salon Tycoon Is Accused of Hiding $29.6 Million From the I.R.S. |work=[[The New York Times]] |date=November 16, 2012 |access-date=April 22, 2018}}</ref><ref name="cnas">{{Cite news |date=2020-01-22 |title=How Soccer Stars Ali Krieger and Ashlyn Harris Want to Bridge the Gap Between Beauty and Sports |language=en-US |url=https://www.vogue.com/article/ali-krieger-ashlyn-harris-bumble-bumble-campaign-beauty-hair |access-date=2021-12-08}}</ref>

The company operates one flagship salon location in New York City.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.bumbleandbumble.com/locations | title=Locations }}</ref> 

Bumble and Bumble is one of 27 [[brand]]s owned by [[Estée Lauder Companies]], Inc.<ref name= "acquisition">{{cite news |last=Lieberman |first=Allyson |url= https://nypost.com/2000/06/03/estee-lauder-buys-bumble/ |title=Estee Lauder Buys Bumble |work=[[New York Post]] |date=June 3, 2000 |access-date=April 22, 2018}}</ref>
